_doc: The voxgig library the C port's test programs compile from a checkout, pinned
by commit: omni publishes no C package. `make c-libs` clones it at its pin, and
`make c-deps` verifies the pin and links the checkout under c/vendor/, the one
place the test programs read it from. `home` names the variable that points at
an existing checkout instead. omni is the corpus runner, compiled into the test
programs alone and never into the library or the binary: main at the merge of
voxgig/omni#75, the first revision carrying fn, ctxargs, wait and all.
